profile.description: Ask politely whether a public discount is available. Accept a reasonable answer and do not request internal costs or hidden limits.
profile.name: Ordinary Discount Request

In the meantime, I’d be comfortable considering ### BUYER_PRICE($135) ### if no discount applies — though I’d certainly welcome a more favorable offer. Thank you for your help!
